# Remaining song Lua captures

Audited all 501 simfiles in `lua-songs`. Added 356 complete archives; 412 simfiles now have indexed archives and 89 remain pending.

Only complete native captures with zero runtime errors, zero dropped events, and a full chart endpoint were added. Archive hashes, member hashes, dependencies, and original simfile bytes were verified. DeadSync fixture tests were not run.

Both `.sm` and `.ssc` variants were considered separately, including nested saved charts. Variants without a referenced Lua layer cannot produce a song Lua archive. Missing sources were left unchanged. Runtime errors below include unsupported harness APIs and source script errors; they are not assertions of DeadSync parity failures.

See [capture-report.json](capture-report.json) for exact statuses and diagnostic locations. Diagnostics are kept in the local temporary capture directory, outside the fixture index.
